beats.narration: Engine hesitates when you accelerate. Idle dips or shakes at a stop.

beats.narration: One clue: a clogged EGR valve. Carbon buildup can block it from closing right.

beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on an OBD-II scan-tool screen displaying a P0401 trouble-code readout, screen glow in a dim shop bay, tool mounted/clipped in frame.

beats.narration: Don't guess which part it is. A scan tool narrows it down fast.
beats.visualPrompt: Scan tool connected via cable under the dash, data scrolling on-screen, shop bay softly blurred in the background.
